extracted.name: Apple & ginger mojito
extracted.description: Make a refreshing, fruity apple mojito with warming ginger spice. This autumnal serve is simple and delicious, garnished with apple and a sprig of mint.
ingredient_lines: mint sprig and apple fan, to serve
instruction_lines: Put all ingredients, except for the ginger beer and mint, in a highball glass. Gently stir the drink, then top up with ginger beer. Garnish with the mint sprig and apple slices to serve.
